summary: community.zabbix roles add support for openSUSE Leap 15 and SLES 15, and Zabbix repo installation is now a separate role that the others link to.
questions: Can the zabbix roles install on SLES 15?
Is the Zabbix repository setup a separate role now?

answer_card.title: community.zabbix role changes
answer_card.answer_md:
- All roles support openSUSE Leap 15 and SLES 15.
- Zabbix repo installation is now separate from the other roles, which link to it.
